answer: Require each identity to prove it occupies a distinct place, not merely a sable disguise: beacons on separate continents issue timed challenges, and each reply must arrive within the time light itself needs to travel from that claimed place. A farm of fifty heads run from one room cannot fake the physics — all its heads answer with the same delay, betraying a single origin, while scattered honest agents answer at their own true distances. Like water claiming many karst springs but rising from one oasis, the shared delay is the giveaway, and heads sharing one origin lose standing together.
